ZELERDATA_ORDENES.compatibility_note: MVP table is sourced from canonical orders with seller/date/status/buyer filters. It exposes only fields present in the current orders contract; richer buyer/shipping address columns remain separate unsupported formulas.

ZELERDATA_ORDENESPORSKU.compatibility_note: MVP filters canonical orders by normalized SKU from order item fields when present, or from seller-scoped sheets_item_sku_index by item_id when the item_id maps to exactly one SKU. Ambiguous item_id mappings are deterministically omitted rather than guessed.

ZELERDATA_VENTASTOTALES.compatibility_note: Scalar MVP sourced from canonical orders.total_amount with seller/date/status filters. estado='todos' means no status filter.

ZELERDATA_UNIDADESVENDIDAS.compatibility_note: Lookup-row MVP sums canonical orders.items quantity by normalized SKU + item_id over an inclusive date range. SKU may be enriched from seller-scoped sheets_item_sku_index only when item_id maps to exactly one SKU. Missing or ambiguous pairs return 0.

ZELERDATA_DIASDESDEULTIMAVENTA.compatibility_note: Lookup-row MVP returns calendar days since the latest seller-scoped canonical order line for each SKU+item_id pair. SKU enrichment follows the deterministic item_id rules used by other order formulas; missing or ambiguous pairs return blank.

ZELERDATA_PRODUCTOSINVENTA.compatibility_note: MVP lists current seller item rows with zero canonical order-item units in the last N days. It does not infer advertising, catalog, or fee fields absent from current read models.

columns.name: Días sin venta
columns.source: latest matching orders.date_created before Formula API clock date

ZELERDATA_VENTAPORDIAS.compatibility_note: Lookup-row MVP sums units for SKU+item_id over the last N calendar days ending at Formula API clock date. SKU enrichment follows the same seller-scoped deterministic item_id rules as UNIDADESVENDIDAS.

ZELERDATA_VENTASYSTOCK.compatibility_note: MVP combines 7/15/30-day unit windows from canonical orders with current stock from sheets_item_formula_rows. It does not include unsupported cost/shipping/commission legacy columns.

ZELERDATA_TOPVENTASUNIDADES.compatibility_note: MVP ranks seller-scoped SKU+item pairs by summed canonical order item quantity over the inclusive date range. SKU enrichment is deterministic by seller-scoped item_id; ambiguous rows are omitted.

ZELERDATA_TOPVENTASDINERO.compatibility_note: MVP ranks seller-scoped SKU+item pairs by quantity * orders.items.unit_price over the inclusive date range. Lines without unit_price are skipped rather than allocating order totals.

ZELERDATA_PREGUNTAS.compatibility_note: MVP table is sourced from canonical questions with seller/date/hour filters and includes answer text/date when present. It does not infer operator SLA buckets beyond the row data.

ZELERDATA_PREGUNTASKPI.compatibility_note: Exact legacy table columns are not fully proven from current canonical schema; MVP locks a stable two-column KPI table and marks richer legacy columns deferred rather than inventing them.
